proposal.summary: An intent-sending vulnerability in com.full.dialer.top.secure.encrypted (<= 1.0.1) allows any installed app with no permissions to place phone calls without user interaction via the DialerActivity component.
proposal.cwe_quote: enables any installed application (with no permissions) to place phone calls without user interaction by sending a crafted intent via the com.full.dialer.top.secure.encrypted.activities.DialerActivity component.

AV.quote: enables any installed application (with no permissions) to place phone calls without user interaction by sending a crafted intent via the com.full.dialer.top.secure.encrypted.activities.DialerActivity component.

PR.quote: enables any installed application (with no permissions) to place phone calls

proposal.recommended_next_step: Confirm exploitability by reproducing the intent send to com.full.dialer.top.secure.encrypted.activities.DialerActivity on a device running the affected app, and implement intent validation or require appropriate permissions before initiating calls.

evidence_quotes.claim: No permissions needed; any installed app can trigger calls
evidence_quotes.quote: enables any installed application (with no permissions) to place phone calls

evidence_quotes.claim: Attack vector is a crafted intent to DialerActivity
evidence_quotes.quote: by sending a crafted intent via the com.full.dialer.top.secure.encrypted.activities.DialerActivity component.
